checks.name: Exact configuration and preserved candidate/staging identity
command:
import hashlib,json,os,stat,sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.dont_write_bytecode=True
root=Path.cwd()
def fingerprint(base):
 rows=[]
 for directory,dirs,names in os.walk(base,followlinks=False):
  for name in sorted(dirs+names):
   p=Path(directory)/name
   assert not p.is_symlink(),str(p)
  for name in sorted(names):
   p=Path(directory)/name
   assert p.is_file(),str(p)
   rows.append([p.relative_to(base).as_posix(),hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),p.stat().st_size,oct(stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode))])
 rows.sort()
 return {'files':len(rows),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(rows,separators=(',',':')).encode()).hexdigest()}
inventory=json.loads((root/'.taskplane/bootstrap/remediation-v6-source-inventory.json').read_text())['files']
for name,expected in inventory.items():
 p=root/name
 assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(),name
 actual={'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'mode':oct(stat.S_IMODE(p.stat().st_mode))}
 assert actual==expected,name
assert len(inventory)==520
assert (root/'components.yaml').read_bytes()==b'exclude:\n  - work/runtime-activation-v5\n'
evidence=json.loads((root/'.taskplane/remediation-v6/build/native-evidence.json').read_text())
assert fingerprint(root/'work/runtime-activation-v5')==evidence['staging_preservation']['before']
graph=json.loads((root/'.taskplane/knowledge/graph.json').read_text())
assert graph['meta']['scanners']['excluded']=={'declared_in':'components.yaml','prefixes':['work/runtime-activation-v5']}
assert not graph['meta']['scanners'].get('exclude_error')
assert not graph['meta']['graph_scan_quality']['degraded']
files=graph['files']
assert not any(p=='work/runtime-activation-v5' or p.startswith('work/runtime-activation-v5/') for p in files)
assert any(p.startswith('work/taskplane-remediation/') for p in files)
assert 'work/taskplane-remediation/taskplane/depgraph.py' in files
print(json.dumps({'status':'pass','scope':'configuration and source/evidence preservation only','candidate_files':520,'configuration':'exact','staging':'unchanged','graph_exclusion':'exact','functional_tests':'deferred to Engineering; no pass claimed'}))
